name: Cerebral Barbell (Greater)
text:
This tiny metallic barbell is strangely heavy for its size. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is +14 and the DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 24.
- Armor You gain resistance 2 to force.

- Weapon After casting a spell by Activating the cerebral barbell, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 3 force damage until the end of your next turn.
